== 2014 Holotable image ==
[[File:VB2-L-anakinslightsaber-pre.gif|thumb|Block 2 face distributed by Holotable in December 2014]]
The standard full-card image from the December 2014 Holotable Set 0 folder retains the Block 2 diamond. Its deployment targets and weapon-destiny cancellation match the Modern slip.<ref>[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable post-reset image archive], December 2014, member <code>cards/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/anakinslightsaber.gif</code>.</ref>

== Early Set 0 sheet ==
The 2014 regular slip has the same deployment targets and weapon-destiny cancellation as the later full-card image.<ref>Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Set 0], official text as of 1 August 2016, page 13.</ref>
